title: Practice 2: пере-: across, and over to another place

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Кто ___ (перевести / переводить) Коран на иврит?
exercises.why: **перевёл** is the past tense (masculine) of **перевести** (to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **переводить**. past: он перевёл · она перевела́ · оно перевело́ · они перевели́. — Wiktionary, «перевести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  Wiktionary's senses of **перевести**: to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret [with с (s, + genitive) ‘from a language’ and на (na, + accusative) ‘into a language’]; to remit (money).  «The verbs "носить", "возить" and "водить" have basically the same prefixes as the verbs of motion we have studied previously with corresponding changes in meaning. However, many of the prefixed verbs have also secondary meanings, some of which are more important than the basic meanings.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  «переводить — перевести — to lead over; to transfer, to translate. Note the following meanings:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ты когда-нибудь ___ (переплывать / переплыть) реку?
exercises.why: **переплывал** is the past tense (masculine) of **переплывать** (to swim across; to sail across) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **переплыть**. past: он переплыва́л · она переплыва́ла · оно переплыва́ло · они переплыва́ли. — Wiktionary, «переплывать» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**пере-** — Movement across, from one point to another; through Example: Утки переплыли реку. — The ducks swam across the river. Prepositional phrases: через + acc.; without preposition + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «The prefix "пере-" implies the following meanings: a) Going across or over something. In this case the verb is commonly followed by the preposition через + Acc. However, sometimes this preposition is omitted and the verb takes a direct object: Мы перешли через улицу. Мы перешли улицу. — We crossed the street. b) Moving from one place to another. In this case the verb may be followed by any preposition indicating motion to or from a place: Мы переехали на другую квартиру. — moved to … Мы переехали из города в деревню. — moved from … to …» — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ты умеешь ___ (переводить / перевести) Цельсии в Фаренгейты?
exercises.why: **переводить** (the infinitive) (to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret [with с (s, + genitive) ‘from a language’ and на (na, + accusative) ‘into a language’]) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **перевести**. — Wiktionary, «переводить» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**пере-** — Movement across, from one point to another; through Example: Утки переплыли реку. — The ducks swam across the river. Prepositional phrases: через + acc.; without preposition + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «The prefix "пере-" implies the following meanings: a) Going across or over something. In this case the verb is commonly followed by the preposition через + Acc. However, sometimes this preposition is omitted and the verb takes a direct object: Мы перешли через улицу. Мы перешли улицу. — We crossed the street. b) Moving from one place to another. In this case the verb may be followed by any preposition indicating motion to or from a place: Мы переехали на другую квартиру. — moved to … Мы переехали из города в деревню. — moved from … to …» — DLI, Lesson 62.  «переводить — перевести — to lead over; to transfer, to translate. Note the following meanings:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  Compare: «Я перевёл детей через дорогу.» (to lead over (across)) — DLI, Lesson 79. «Меня перевели в другой полк.» (to transfer) — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он ___ (перевести / переводить) Гомера с греческого на английский.
exercises.why: **перевёл** is the past tense (masculine) of **перевести** (to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **переводить**. past: он перевёл · она перевела́ · оно перевело́ · они перевели́. — Wiktionary, «перевести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  Wiktionary's senses of **перевести**: to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret [with с (s, + genitive) ‘from a language’ and на (na, + accusative) ‘into a language’]; to remit (money).  «The verbs "носить", "возить" and "водить" have basically the same prefixes as the verbs of motion we have studied previously with corresponding changes in meaning. However, many of the prefixed verbs have also secondary meanings, some of which are more important than the basic meanings.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  «переводить — перевести — to lead over; to transfer, to translate. Note the following meanings:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
